svg.title: Joiner, Mover, Leaver access workflow
svg.desc: Proposed identity lifecycle workflow showing approvals, exceptions, verification, and risk controls.

text.tspan: A proposed control design for onboarding, role changes and offboarding
Grant only access approved for the new role.
Remove obsolete access when responsibilities change.
Disable access at departure and track unresolved exceptions.
Late notice: act promptly and escalate.
Proposed controls • Not evidence of implementation
